outcome: persistent pulmonary hypertension of the neonate (PPHN)
cohort: A late preterm infant born at 35 6/7 weeks gestational age and their mother who was subsequently diagnosed with choriocarcinoma.
finding: This case describes a late preterm infant with severe chronic anemia and persistent pulmonary hypertension secondary to fetomaternal hemorrhage, which led to the subsequent diagnosis of maternal choriocarcinoma.
mod_finding: The infant was born via cesarean section for non-reassuring fetal heart tones.
